name: status-indicator
purpose: Use StatusIndicator for the current state of one resource (Active, Failed, Deploying) in a table column or detail header — the default answer for 'status'. A category or outcome word is a Tag, a number is a Badge, a level on the critical → info scale is a SeverityTag, and an HTTP code is a StatusCode. Shows the settled or transitional state of one resource as a colored dot (or a spinner while `loading`) beside a short label: Active, Failed, Paused, Deploying. It is the status column of tables and lists and the status line of a detail header, so it is static text, not a live region.
useWhen: The state of a resource in a table cell, a list row or a detail header: Active, Failed, Paused.
A transitional state such as Deploying or Propagating, with `loading`.
avoidWhen: A count or a very short label attached to another element → use `badge`.
A category or status chip with an optional icon → use `tag`.
A page or section notice with copy and actions → use `alert`.
related: `badge` — filled count indicator, usually overlaid on an icon or avatar.
`tag` — labelled chip for categories and statuses.
`spinner` — replaces the dot while `loading` is true.
`progress` — continuous progress instead of a discrete state.
bestPractices: Always pass `label`. The default is the literal `'Status'`, and the color alone does not carry the meaning.
Map `severity` to meaning and keep it consistent across the app: `success`, `info`, `warning` and `danger` follow their tokens and `neutral` is muted.

With `loading`, pass the bare verb (`"Deploying"`). The component appends the ellipsis character (`…`, not three periods) and swaps the dot for a spinner. A label that already ends in `…` or `...` (copy pasted from a design: `"Building..."`) is trimmed first, so it renders `Building…`, never `Building......`.

It is a non-interactive element with no role, no click and no keyboard behavior. Don't attach handlers to it. When a status change must be announced (a single deploy you are watching), announce it through a toast or a live region the page owns, not by making every indicator live.

props.name: severity
props.doc: Severity token driving the status dot color. `Severity` is the shared status scale, exported from this component (and from `badge` and `tag`).

props.name: loading
props.doc: Transitional state: a spinner replaces the dot and the label gains a trailing ellipsis (`…`), so pass the bare verb; a trailing `…` or `...` already in the label is not doubled.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label text. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Status`).
